A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Model-Dowser research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–H. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison; pages 6–24 are pixel-identical.

before.justification: v3 reports original LLaVA and NVILA fine-tuning experiments in Section 4, plus random-selection comparisons, probing-stability measurements, and continual-learning results in Appendices F–H.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–2 and the continual-learning evaluation in Table 9.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same importance score, synthetic probing, sensitivity estimation, binary masking, and sparse updates. The Appendix D surrogate is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same COCO-Caption, Flickr30k, ImageNet-R, and IconQA tasks and upstream benchmarks. Appendix H retains the same five continual-learning domains and associated evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: the main comparisons retain zero-shot, Full-FT, Grafting, DARE, Tailor, and SPIDER; the supplementary comparisons retain random selection and the same continual-learning baselines, including MoeLORA.

E3.justification: The model configurations, depth and update-ratio sweeps, metrics, and continual-learning protocol are unchanged. Section 4.1 still specifies 10,000 training instances per downstream dataset, five epochs, and a learning rate of 2×10^-5.

E4.justification: The fine-tuning-depth, update-ratio, random-selection, and synthetic-probing stability analyses are retained without additions or revisions in Section 4 and Appendices F–G.

E5.justification: Both versions retain standard deviations across three random seeds in Tables 4, 6, and 7, five independent runs in Table 8, and the same significance-test descriptions and p-values.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains NVILA H-scores of 85.7 on COCO-Caption and 71.2 on ImageNet-R, while Table 9 retains Model-Dowser's BWT of -2.5 and H-score of 63.8.

T1.justification: Theorem 3.1, Corollary 3.2, and the derivations and surrogate bounds in Appendices B–D are unchanged. Corollary 3.2's opening moves from page 3 to page 4 without altering its statement.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about forgetting under deeper fine-tuning, data-free parameter importance, knowledge preservation, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: The interpretations of functional sensitivity, baseline failures, and stability are unchanged. Appendix H preserves the same distinction between downstream adaptation and continual learning; no substantive qualifications or limitations are added.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain unchanged, including GPU configurations, batch size, N=64 synthetic samples, R=8 Rademacher vectors, and implementation links. The updated arXiv self-link supplies no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendices A and H are unchanged. The paper's own publication-notice update does not revise its relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v4 replaces 'Preprint. March 13, 2026.' with an ICML 2026 proceedings and copyright notice and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific wording, terminology, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer first-page publication notice causes limited text and equation reflow across pages 1–5. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–9 retain their content and design, and pages 6–24 have identical rendered layouts.

improvement.justification: v4 updates publication metadata and associated page flow while preserving the scientific text, proofs, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information throughout the main paper and appendices. These administrative and layout edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
